title: Value-Indexed Knapsack
statement:
Use value-indexed 0/1 knapsack DP to maximize total value at weight at most W. Each item can be taken once.

Input
n W, then n lines weight value.

Output
Print the maximum total value.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 0 ≤ W ≤ 10¹⁴. Weights are positive and at most 10¹². Values lie in [1,1000].
